move: rule draws, label and title lines rise through masks, all retract upward
how: A cream stage with an orange blob top-right and a faint dark blob bottom-left that breathe (sine.inOut yoyo) for the whole clip, a frame with a top rule, a dotted label, two 132px title lines (accent word), a subline, a footer rule and footer items, all in overflow masks. The rule grows scaleX 0 to 1 (expo.inOut, first 22%), the dot pops with back.out(2), label spans rise yPercent 110 to 0 (expo.out, 0.08 stagger), title lines rise with a 0.12 stagger (expo.out, 0.9s, at 11%), then the subline, the footer rule and footer items. From 79% the lines exit yPercent -110 (expo.in, 0.08 stagger), the subline, label and footer follow, the dot shrinks, and both rules retract (expo.inOut), leaving the blobs as at the start.
adapt: Change the episode label, two title lines (keep one accent word), subline, footer strings and date, the blob colours; keep the expo.inOut rule draw and the 0.12s title stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the frame and masked rows; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with title at 0.11D and exit at 0.79D. Scope selectors to el; direct port.
